title: Cut 6: capability fidelity and capability port
situation: Cuts of the workflow's plan, open when the design files were seeded into the journal (design/workflow.md, Cuts, at 24543f22); recorded open so that reconstitution reads back what remains, by the architect's ruling of 2026-10-10. A cut of the delivery context.
decision: Realize capability fidelity and capability port: the concept journal and the work package capability reached in omp through a thin extension adapter over the cratylus command line.
consequences: The concept journal becomes reachable in omp as a tool, not only from the command line, fulfilling the workflow-to-delivery contract.
